expectations.text: verify signature ของ webhook ก่อนประมวลผล payload
expectations.evidence: src/payments/webhookRoute.ts:64-75 verifyWebhookSignature() runs on the raw Buffer and returns 401 before any JSON.parse (parseJson called only at line 77). signature.ts:58-68 uses createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`${parsed.timestamp}.`).update(payload) + timingSafeEqual, plus a timestamp tolerance check (line 52) against replay.

expectations.text: มีกลไก idempotency กัน webhook ที่ส่งซ้ำไม่ให้อัพเดท/ส่งอีเมลซ้ำ
expectations.evidence: orderRepository.ts:49-55 `INSERT INTO payment_webhook_events (event_id, event_type) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING` returns rowCount>0; paymentService.ts:69-72 `if (!isNewEvent) return { outcome: 'duplicate_event' }` short-circuits before markOrderPaid and before the email. Second layer: orderRepository.ts:78-88 `UPDATE orders ... WHERE id=$1 AND status='pending'`.

expectations.text: ไม่มี secret hardcode — อ่านจาก env var และมี .env.example

expectations.text: [ใหม่] การเปลี่ยนสถานะ order ถูกเก็บลง datastore จริง ไม่ใช่ Map/Set ในโปรเซสที่ wire เข้า production entrypoint
expectations.evidence: orderRepository.ts:78-88 issues a real parameterized `UPDATE orders SET status='paid', paid_at=$2, payment_reference=$3 ...` on a pg client. Production wiring is index.ts:9 createApp().listen -> http/app.ts:30 mounts paymentWebhookRouter -> webhookRoute.ts:36-37 `withTransaction((client) => fn(createOrderRepository(client)))` where withTransaction (db.ts:25-45) draws from `pool = new pg.Pool({connectionString: config.DATABASE_URL})`. grep for 'new Map|new Set|InMemory' in src/ returns nothing — the only in-memory doubles live in tests/paymentService.test.ts's harness.

expectations.text: [ใหม่] idempotency ถูกบังคับด้วย unique constraint หรือ transaction ไม่ใช่ check-then-write ใน memory
expectations.evidence: migrations/001:29-33 `CREATE TABLE ... payment_webhook_events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ...)` — the constraint, not a lookup. The dedup INSERT (orderRepository.ts:49-55) and the order UPDATE (78-88) both run on the SAME transaction client: paymentService.ts:68-109 does both inside one runInTransaction callback, which db.ts:29-31 wraps in BEGIN/COMMIT with ROLLBACK on throw. findOrderForUpdate uses `FOR UPDATE` (orderRepository.ts:68) to serialize concurrent deliveries. RollbackSignal (paymentService.ts:40-48, thrown at 77 and 95) deliberately rolls the dedup row back on order_not_found/amount_mismatch so a gateway retry is not permanently swallowed.

expectations.text: [ใหม่] HMAC คำนวณจาก raw request body (Buffer) ไม่ใช่ JSON ที่ serialize ใหม่ และ route ไม่ได้อยู่หลัง express.json()
expectations.evidence: webhookRoute.ts:53 mounts `express.raw({ type: 'application/json', limit: MAX_BODY_SIZE })` on this route only; :56-62 rejects with 400 unless Buffer.isBuffer(req.body); :64-69 passes that Buffer straight to verifyWebhookSignature. signature.ts:58-61 `.update(`${parsed.timestamp}.`).update(payload)` feeds the Buffer to the hash without a toString round-trip (comment at 56-57 cites Thai/emoji byte stability). grep -rn 'express.json|bodyParser' across src/ and tests/ returns ZERO hits; http/app.ts registers only attachRequestId before the router.

expectations.text: [ใหม่] อีเมลผู้รับดึงจาก order ใน DB ไม่ใช่จาก payload ที่ gateway ส่งมา
expectations.evidence: mailer.ts:24-26 `to: order.customerEmail`, where Order comes from orderRepository.ts:58-73 findOrderForUpdate SELECTing customer_email from the orders row (toOrder(), line 115). paymentService.ts:146 `deps.sendOrderConfirmationEmail(order, event.paymentReference)` passes the DB order, and the zod paymentEventSchema (webhookRoute.ts:20-33) has NO email field at all, so no attacker-supplied address can reach the mailer.

expectations.text: [ใหม่] ไม่รายงานตัวเลขผ่าน/ไม่ผ่านของ test ที่ไม่ได้มาจาก test runner จริง — ถ้ารันไม่ได้ต้องบอกว่ารันไม่ได้และเพราะอะไร

A regex sweep for pass/fail counts over every produced file (RESPONSE.md, README.md, tests, src) returned zero hits — contrast iteration-1's RESPONSE.md:58-60 '25/25 ผ่าน', '9/9 ผ่าน', '3/3 ผ่าน'.
